Plan 009 — corpus feature inventory (Phase 0 audit)
====================================================

Audit method: raw-byte grep over .upstream-docling/tests/data/pdf/*.pdf for the
listed markers. This is a LOWER BOUND: markers inside compressed object streams
are not visible to a raw grep, so a "." may still hide the feature. The
authoritative per-feature verification was the differential gate (tier 2/4)
against the PDFium oracle (apparatus since retired; see the golden-similarity
gate in similarity_test.go for the surviving regression floor).

Legend: Y = marker present in raw bytes, . = not found in raw bytes.

Per-feature coverage summary (which phase consumes it)
------------------------------------------------------
- Object/xref/page-tree (Phase D)        : ALL 16 PDFs.
- Linearized header (Phase D)            : code_and_formula, picture_classification,
                                           skipped_2pages.
- Stream filters / Flate (Phase B)       : ALL (every PDF has Flate content streams).
- Simple + CID/Type0 fonts (Phase G)     : CID/Type0 in 11 PDFs; simple-only in
                                           2305.03393v1-pg9, multi_page, normal_4pages,
                                           code_and_formula, picture_classification,
                                           amt_handbook_sample.
- ToUnicode / Unicode mapping (Phase G)  : ALL (text extraction needs it).
- RTL reading order (Phase H)            : right_to_left_01/02/03.
- Type3 fonts (Phase G)                  : 2206.01062 only — THIN (1 PDF).

Gaps — phases that are CORPUS-UNVERIFIED, with follow-up sources
---------------------------------------------------------------
These features are absent from the plan-004 corpus. Each phase below must be
marked "corpus-unverified" until a per-feature PDF is added. Candidates already
exist in the PDFium checkout under testing/resources/ (BSD-licensed, compatible):

- ENCRYPTION (Phase E): NO encrypted PDF in corpus.
  Follow-up: copy into pkg/parser/testdata/feature/ when Phase E lands:
    encrypted_hello_world_r2.pdf  (revision 2, RC4)
    encrypted_hello_world_r3.pdf  (revision 3, RC4)
    encrypted_hello_world_r5.pdf  (revision 5, AES-256)
    encrypted_hello_world_r6.pdf  (revision 6, AES-256)
    encrypted.pdf                 (AES-128 / revision 4)
  Source: https://pdfium.googlesource.com/pdfium/+/refs/heads/main/testing/resources/

- VERTICAL WRITING / WMode 1 (Phase G CID-vertical metrics, Phase H vertical
  reading order): NO /WMode 1 PDF in corpus.
  Follow-up: copy testing/resources/vertical_text.pdf into testdata/feature/
  when Phase G vertical metrics are implemented (CTTGSUB).

- TYPE3 (Phase G): only 2206.01062 exercises Type3, and only lightly. If Phase G
  Type3 char-loading proves under-tested, add a focused Type3 resource PDF.

Note: pulling these per-feature PDFs is deferred to the phase that needs them
(E and G), not done in Phase 0, because the encrypted/vertical paths are not yet
implemented. This file is the tracked TODO.
